title: Hi Corey Here (Mucho Gusto I Care Duet) - Sweeter
style: high-energy progressive house duet banger, fast 128-130 BPM festival mainstage energy, less emotional/sappy and more upbeat fun clubby vibe, full male + female duet trading energetic verses and massive layered harmonies, confident male baritone with hype attitude, bright punchy female vocals with party flair and perfect chemistry, driving rolling basslines that thump hard, huge supersaw leads that build and explode in progressive drops, punchy kicks + crisp claps + energetic percussion, sparkling arpeggios and stabs, minimal dreamy pads (focus on energy), pure vocal percussion acapella breakdowns with beatbox “doom-tss-doom-doom-tss” patterns, layered pink elephant trumpeting FX (“BRRRAAAAH!”) and heavy elephant breathing sounds (“hhhuufff”) in drops, bilingual English-Spanish lyrics for extra flavor, professional high-quality studio mix, wide stereo imaging, super catchy addictive chorus, emotional builds into massive euphoric progressive drops with ad-libs, progressive trance
lyrics:
[Intro – Vocal Percussion Acapella Only – fast & tight]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Verse 1 – Male, energetic]
Hi Corey here, nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto mi amigo, donde has estado?
Quiero recordar tu nombre para siempre
Lock it in my corazón, no more games
[Verse 2 – Female, upbeat]
Me importa, sí me importa de verdad
Te lo muestro porque sí, porque me importa a mí
Fue nice to meet you, se sintió tan real
Ahora nos ponemos al día, tú y yo
[Pre-Chorus – Both, building hype]
Year 1 teacher asked “if you had one wish, qué sería?”
“I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan”
Mrs. Steinerprice dijo “es para ti, not me”
Pero yo dije “es para todos, para ti y para mí”
[Chorus – Duet, massive progressive drop]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
[Vocal Percussion Break – Pure Acapella Only, faster]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Pink Elephant Trumpeting Drop – Both + FX]
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH! (pink elephant trumpet!)
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH! (pink elephant breathing hard!)
[Verse 3 – Male, high energy]
From the older songs and the CoreyAI fire
Friendships on the rise, we take it higher
Previous thread, recent laughs still alive
All my wishes already come true, that’s no lie
[Verse 4 – Female, fun & bilingual]
Quiero que cada deseo se haga realidad
Para todos, no solo para mí, esa es la verdad
It was nice to meet you, felt so warm y true
Now we catch up again like we always do
[Bridge – Both, half-time then massive build]
I care… me importa… we both care…
Nombres recordados, deseos en el aire…
Hasta la vista never means goodbye
Just “nos vemos pronto” under the sky…
SongPal forever, that’s the vibe we ride
[Final Chorus – Duet, biggest drop + ad-libs]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
( ad-libs: BRRRAAAAH! … doom-tss-doom-doom-tss … deseos se cumplan! )
[Outro – Vocal Percussion Fade + Elephant FX]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH!
Hi Corey here… mucho gusto… SongPal forever…
(desires se cumplan… catch up again…)
